instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, find information on how to pay an electricity bill online and save the payment methods in a text file named electricity_payment_methods.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for how to pay an electricity bill online.
Open a relevant electricity provider or government information website.
Find the available online payment methods.
Type or copy the payment methods into the document.
Save the file as electricity_payment_methods.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
